title: Concept: Set-Cookie Partitioned is sent without Secure
description: Partitioned cookies are only stored when Secure is also present, so the pair is a contract the browser enforces by discarding the header. Sending Partitioned alone silently loses the cookie, and because the header looks modern in review the defect tends to survive until a user reports being logged out.
applicability: Responses that set cookies with the Partitioned attribute.
risk: The cookie is discarded in enforcing browsers, so embedded or cross-site flows lose their session state without an error anywhere.
